title: Good but sad.
body: I love this app so much. I originally used the website which was free, but I saw that there is an app to download. I didn’t mind paying that little bit because goblin tools has never let me down. But for some reason, when I use the app, it just crashes on me. I can’t use it what so ever. So I have to stick with pulling my browser out and using it there. Which isn’t overly bad, but I bought it for the convenience of not having to do that. At first I thought it was just my phone that was the problem, I have a relatively new phone iPhone 16 pro max, so then I decided to use my ipad air 11 M2 to see if it would work but sadly not. It just crashes again. Am I doing something wrong? My storage is good on both devices..
author: krugerjade2

title: Work in Progress
body:
Random scale of 80 percent done. The sync function is purely beta, but extremely buggy. Purchased yesterday have had to shut it down 10 times just because it was on a blank screen, this down not include the times it shut down on its own which was more than 10. This would be an excellent app if it didn’t shut down, it makes it more frustrating to use than not but the idea features when it does work are such a great idea.
I paid for this but hopefully will get a refund best to use the online web versions
